sources.title: Search Antitrust Remedies September2 2025 updatedApril15 2026
sources.excerpt: Court prohibited exclusive distribution contracts for Search,Chrome,Assistant,Gemini; certain index/user-interaction data made available to rivals; search/search-text-ad syndication offered. Cannot condition licensing on placements, bundle placement revenue shares, condition continued placement payments for more than one year, or prohibit simultaneous distribution of competitors. DOJ describes historical approximately90% US search queries, not current2026 observed marketshare. This announcement does not establish current appeal/stay implementation status.

sources.title: Ad Tech Antitrust Remedies September16 2026
sources.excerpt: EDVirginia ordered behavioral relief: AdX/DFP integrations with Prebid and competing publisher ad servers; publishers can export their DFP/AdX data; AdWords nondiscriminatory bidding and no direct bids into DFP; anti-self-preferencing; six-year monitor/technical committee. DOJ continues reviewing nextsteps. Announcement supports behavioral remedies, not assumed divestiture or finalized no-appeal implementation.
